name: Default Shooting
summary: Considerable boost to Shooting attributes when in Takeover.
detail: Boost to all Shooting attributes by +30, up to a maximum of 80.

name: Shot Artist
summary: Enhances ability to make Off-Dribble shots.
detail: Wider timing window on off-dribble jumpers, making it easier to convert off any dribble move.

name: Calibrated
summary: Enhances ability to make Set shots.
detail: Wider timing window on catch-and-shoot and stand-still jumpers, rewarding disciplined shot selection with an easier green.

name: Zip Code
summary: Extends ability to make shots from Deep.
detail: Extends effective shooting range, allowing deep shots to be treated as if taken from closer distances. Fire from further out without the penalty of range.

name: Default Finishing
summary: Considerable boost to Finishing attributes when in Takeover.
detail: Boost to all Finishing attributes by +30, up to a maximum of 80.

name: Navigator
summary: Enhances ability to make Driving and Advanced layups (euros, hops, spins).
detail: Wider timing window on driving and advanced layups, with advanced gather animations that help you navigate through traffic and finish at the rim.

name: Airspace
summary: Enhances ability to make Driving dunks.
detail: Take flight on every drive, forcing contact dunk situations, powering through defenders, and finishing alley-oops with ease.

name: Inside Touch
summary: Enhances ability to make Standing layups.
detail: Wider timing window on standing layups, making it easier to finish softly around the basket.

name: Detonator
summary: Enhances ability to make Standing dunks.
detail: Wider timing window on standing dunks, turning catches in the paint and mid-post feeds into reliable rim-rocking opportunities.

name: Paint Surgeon
summary: Enhances ability to make Post Hooks, Fades, and win matchups in the post.
detail: Easily beat defenders with post backdowns, moves, and fakes. Wider timing window on post shots to finish with precision.

name: Default Playmaking
summary: Considerable boost to Playmaking attributes when in Takeover.
detail: Boost to all Playmaking attributes by +30, up to a maximum of 80.

name: Blur
summary: Enhances ability to blow by defenders and win body-up matchups.
detail: Enhances the ability to drive by defenders, making it easier to get to the rim.

name: Cook
summary: Increases chances of successful ankle breakers.
detail: Increased chance to trigger defender reactions and devastating anklebreakers.

name: Dishmaster
summary: Increases boosts to pass recipient's Finishing and Shooting attributes.
detail: Elevates all teammates' Finishing and Shooting discipline attributes, with crisp passes that can reach players anywhere on the court.

name: Default Defense
summary: Considerable boost to Defense attributes when in Takeover.
detail: Boost to all Defense attributes by +30, up to a maximum of 80.

name: Glue
summary: Enhances ability to force ball pickups and fumbles.
detail: Apply relentless pressure on ball handlers to shut down their options, while powering through screens to stay attached on every possession.

name: Hawk
summary: Activates on-ball steal attempts that can cause turnovers or force fumbles.
detail: Higher efficiency in forcing fumbles and getting on-ball steals.

name: Rim Guardian
summary: Increases ability to win post and off-ball post situations, and activates elite shot blocking around the rim.
detail: Boosts ability to defend around the basket and in the post.

name: Default Rebounding
summary: Considerable boost to Rebounding attributes when in Takeover.
detail: Boost to all Rebounding attributes by +30, up to a maximum of 80.

name: Demolition
summary: Increases ability to set strong screens.
detail: Dominate as a screener with boosted screen resolutions, unlocking punishing animations that flatten unsuspecting defenders.

name: Muscle
summary: Increases ability to win successful boxouts and rebounds.
detail: Overpower opponents on the glass with superior boxouts and explosive rebounds.

name: Second Chance
summary: Instantly see shot feedback on all shots, and increase ability to make successful putbacks.
detail: Instantly see feedback on all shots, and increased chance of successful putbacks.

name: See the Future
summary: Shows you where missed shots will land ahead of time.
detail: See the miss coming. Know exactly where the ball will land before anyone else does.

name: Hydration Hero
summary: Temporarily disables losing adrenaline and energy/turbo. Can be equipped in any of the five Takeover Ability discipline slots.
detail: Prevents adrenaline and energy (Turbo R2) drain, letting you push the pace with and without the ball. Rehydrate, replenish, and refuel with Gatorade to help you play at your best.
